# Professional Wood Interiors

> Family-owned custom cabinetry and kitchen remodeling company serving the St. Louis, Missouri metro area since 1985. Specializing in cabinet refacing and full kitchen remodeling, plus custom bookcases, built-ins, and entertainment centers.

Professional Wood Interiors is based in Maryland Heights, MO and has been building and renovating cabinetry for St. Louis area homeowners since 1985. The two core services are **cabinet refacing** (renewing the look of sound existing cabinets without a full tear-out) and **kitchen remodeling** (full-scope remodels including custom solid-wood cabinetry). The company also builds custom bookcases, built-ins, and entertainment centers. Work is designed and built locally; consultations are free.

- Name: Professional Wood Interiors
- Founded: 1985 (family-owned)
- Address: 12031 Wesford Dr, Maryland Heights, MO 63043
- Phone: (314) 437-9988
- Email: dave@prowoodinteriors.com
- Hours: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM
- Service area: St. Louis metro — primary cities Chesterfield, Wildwood, and Clayton

## Core Services

- [Cabinet Refacing](https://www.prowoodinteriors.com/services/cabinet-refacing): A brand-new look for structurally sound cabinets without a full tear-out — new doors, drawer fronts, and matching surfaces.
- [Kitchen Remodeling](https://www.prowoodinteriors.com/services/kitchen-remodeling): Full kitchen remodels and custom solid-wood cabinets, designed and built locally.
- [Custom Bookcases & Built-Ins](https://www.prowoodinteriors.com/services/custom-bookcases): Floor-to-ceiling storage and display, made to measure.
- [Entertainment Centers](https://www.prowoodinteriors.com/services/entertainment-centers): Media walls and fireplace surrounds built to anchor the room.
